items.title: How a Brazilian snake's venom led to a widely used blood pressure drug

items.title: Lodha Developers profit rises 28% YoY to Rs 1,013 crore in Sept quarter
items.description: Lodha has announced a remarkable 63% surge in net profit, reaching ₹2,386 crore for the first half of FY27. This growth is driven by impressive operational performance, with net profit for the September quarter rising by 28% to ₹1,013 crore and revenue climbing 18% to ₹4,468 crore. The company’s pre-sales also saw a 10% increase to ₹5,037 crore, alongside plans for expansion in NCR and Bengaluru.

items.title: Sun Pharma Q2 profit takes a hit on exceptional items
items.description: Sun Pharmaceutical has seen a notable 36% drop in net profit, juxtaposed with an 11.8% rise in consolidated revenue. The uplift in revenue can be attributed largely to strong sales growth in India and emerging markets, particularly in domestic formulations. Conversely, US formulation sales faced a significant downturn. The company also marked progress in its integration planning for the acquisition of Organon, following the successful completion of regulatory approvals.

items.title: Total construction ban in Delhi-NCR from Nov 5 to 20
items.author: KUSHAGRA DIXIT
items.description: The national capital region will implement a complete ban on construction and demolition activities from November 5 to 20. This measure is part of a broader initiative to combat rising winter pollution levels. Union environment minister Bhupender Yadav confirmed that there would be no rollback of existing vehicle entry restrictions. Additionally, swift actions will target non-conforming industries and pollution hotspots in the region.

items.description: PM नरेंद्र मोदी ने शनिवार को सरदार वल्लभभाई पटेल की 151वीं जयंती पर 'स्टैच्यू ऑफ यूनिटी' पर लोगों को राष्ट्रीय एकता की शपथ दिलाई। इससे पहले वे सुबह 'स्टैच्यू ऑफ यूनिटी' पहुंचे और श्रद्धांजलि दी। यहां उन्होंने 400 करोड़ रुपए से ज्यादा की विकास योजनाओं का उद्घाटन किया। इसके बाद उन्होंने रेन फॉरेस्ट और वामन वृक्ष वाटिका का दौरा किया।

items.title: A mother who had to quit her Rs 50 LPA job, now changing chess scene in North India
items.author: JYOTIRMOY HALDER
items.description: After leaving her Rs 50 LPA corporate career to support her daughter Shivika’s chess ambitions, Nidhi Bhasin Rohilla discovered gaps in Delhi’s chess ecosystem. She set out to build what was missing, creating an academy, tournaments, and communities for players across ages and abilities. Today, her initiatives span eight states, championing accessibility, inclusion and a culture where chess thrives beyond ratings, titles and competition.

items.title: Tamil Nadu IT worker leads 43-member group to restore village water
items.author: etimes.in
items.description: Inspired by a gram sabha meeting, M Velmurugan founded a civic association in Vellur, Tamil Nadu, to address pressing local challenges like water supply, burial ground amenities, and pollution control. The group actively works with government representatives to demand accountability and prompt resolutions. Their initiatives also feature educational programs for students about hygiene and environmental conservation through tree planting, establishing a positive influence on the village.

items.title: Indiana landlord's $6,200 award cut to $2,400 over missing damage list
items.author: TOI WORLD DESK
items.description: An Indiana landlord who won $6,200 from a former tenant over unpaid rent and apartment damage has had the award reduced to $2,400. In an October 29 ruling, the state appeals court found that the landlord had failed to provide the tenant with a written list of damages as required by law. The court allowed the unpaid rent claim but rejected the additional cleaning and repair costs.

items.title: 4 killed, 2 injured in fire at Delhi shoe factory; owner summoned
items.author: HADI KHAN
items.description: A fire broke out at a shoe manufacturing factory in Delhi's Mangolpuri Industrial Area, which killed four individuals. Firefighters responded quickly and managed to rescue six people trapped inside the building. Two injured victims were taken to Sanjay Gandhi Memorial Hospital for treatment following the incident. The cause of the fire is currently under investigation by local authorities and police personnel.

items.description: દિલ્હીમાં કોંગ્રેસ અધ્યક્ષ મલ્લિકાર્જુન ખડગેના નિવાસસ્થાને મોક પાર્લામેન્ટ ચાલી રહી છે. પૂર્વ સ્પીકર મીરા કુમાર આ મોક સંસદની અધ્યક્ષતા કરી રહ્યાં છે. કોંગ્રેસ અધ્યક્ષ મલ્લિકાર્જુન ખડગે મુખ્ય ચૂંટણી કમિશનર જ્ઞાનેશ કુમાર વિરુદ્ધ જનમહાભિયોગ લાવશે. આ કાર્યક્રમમાં કોંગ્રેસ સહિત 19 પક્ષોના નેતાઓ સામેલ છે. જાહેર મહાભિયોગમાં જનતા અથવા રાજકીય પક્ષો કોઈ બંધારણીય પદ પર બેઠેલા વ્યક્તિ વિરુદ્ધ વિરોધ વ્યક્ત કરે છે. આ કાર્યક્રમ અગાઉ શુક્રવારે યોજાવાનો હતો, પરંતુ વરસાદને કારણે તેને રદ કરી દેવામાં આવ્યો હતો.

items.title: Nitish Reddy joins unwanted list after horror outing against New Zealand
items.author: PRANAV SHUKLA
items.description: In the fourth T20I against New Zealand, Nitish Reddy had a tough outing, giving away 64 runs and ranking as the second-most expensive bowler in T20I history for India. New Zealand set an impressive target of 259 runs, winning the match by 87 runs and narrowing India’s series lead to 3-1. Glenn Phillips played a vital role with his half-century, while India struggled to reach just 172 runs in response.

items.title: $53M project to build 100 affordable homes amid Miami-Dade shortage
items.author: TOI WORLD DESK
items.description: Miami-Dade is facing an estimated shortage of 118,000 affordable housing units, prompting a $53 million project in Homestead, Florida. Nonprofit Touching Miami with Love plans to transform unused land behind its existing community centre into a five-storey development with 100 affordable homes. The project is expected to break ground in 2027, offering relief to families struggling with rising rents.

items.title: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce donate $1 million to feed 2.4 million New Yorkers
items.author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
items.description: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce donated $26 million to charities across the US, supporting food banks, children's hospitals, education and animal welfare. Their $1 million contribution to New York's City Harvest is expected to help provide food to more than 2.4 million residents this summer. Several nonprofit leaders expressed shock and gratitude after learning about the unexpected gifts, which arrived as many communities face growing financial and food insecurity.

items.description: तमिलनाडु के CM विजय ने शुक्रवार को सरकारी नौकरियों में सीधी भर्ती की अधिकतम उम्र 5 साल बढ़ा दी। नई उम्र सीमा 30 अक्टूबर 2026 से लागू होगी और 5 साल तक प्रभावी रहेगी। यह फैसला सरकारी नौकरी के उम्मीदवारों की मांग पर लिया। सरकार के मुताबिक, इससे उन अभ्यर्थियों को मौका मिलेगा, जो उम्र सीमा के कारण आवेदन से वंचित होने वाले थे। आधिकारिक प्रेस रिलीज के मुताबिक, नई उम्र सीमा नियमों में तय मौजूदा सीमा के अलावा लागू होगी। यह आरक्षित वर्गों को पहले से मिल रही उम्र में छूट के अतिरिक्त होगी। आज की अन्य खबरें…

items.title: भास्कर अपडेट्स:नए एयर चीफ मार्शल आशुतोष दीक्षित ने कार्यभार संभाला; गार्ड ऑफ ऑनर दिया गया; पूर्व एयर चीफ मार्शल एपी सिंह रिटायर हुए
items.description: एयर चीफ मार्शल आशुतोष दीक्षित ने नए चीफ ऑफ एयर स्टाफ के रूप में कार्यभार संभाला। एयर चीफ मार्शल आशुतोष दीक्षित, एक बेहतरीन फाइटर पायलट हैं और उनके पास 20 से अधिक प्रकार के विमानों पर 3,500 घंटे से ज़्यादा उड़ान भरने का अनुभव है, उन्होंने शनिवार को नए 'चीफ ऑफ एयर स्टाफ' के रूप में कार्यभार संभाला। उन्होंने एयर चीफ मार्शल एपी सिंह की जगह ली है, जो 43 साल सेवाएं देने के बाद वायु सेना से सेवानिवृत्त हुए हैं। आज की अन्य खबरें… यूट्यूबर ध्रुव राठी के खिलाफ फिर जारी हुआ वारंट, 2018 के मानहानि केस में…

items.title: Judge approves $47.75m Maui fire settlement, cuts $4.78m in legal fees
items.author: TOI WORLD DESK
items.description: A federal judge has sanctioned a settlement of $47.75 million in a securities lawsuit involving Hawaiian Electric Industries. This case focused on accusations of misleading wildfire preparedness disclosures. The judge notably slashed the legal fees demanded by the investors' attorneys. From over 67,000 claims submitted, only more than 24,000 were approved, highlighting a substantial rejection rate. Payments to eligible claimants will proceed according to a loss-based distribution strategy.
